title: Load Values, Balance Ceilings and Card Fees — Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards Register Reference
content:
For each kind of Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards, the register reference fixes the smallest value a card can be issued or loaded with, the largest value of one card, the largest balance the card may hold after reloads, the fee to buy it, whether value can be added later, and the monthly inactivity fee. All amounts are in US dollars to the cent.

| Card kind | Smallest issue or load | Largest value of one card | Largest balance after reloads | Purchase fee | Reloadable | Monthly inactivity fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Marlowe & Finch Gift Card | $10.00 | $500.00 | $2000.00 | $0.00 | Yes | $0.00 |
| Marlowe & Finch eGift Card | $10.00 | $500.00 | $500.00 | $0.00 | No | $0.00 |
| Merchandise Credit Card | $0.01 | $5000.00 | $5000.00 | $0.00 | No | $0.00 |
| Registry Reward Card | $0.01 | $1500.00 | $1500.00 | $0.00 | No | $0.00 |
| Corporate Gift Card | $25.00 | $500.00 | $500.00 | $0.00 | No | $0.00 |
| Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card | $10.00 | $50.00 | $50.00 | $0.00 | No | $0.00 |

## Notes on the columns

- **Smallest issue or load** is the floor for the value placed on a new card and, on the one reloadable kind, for each later addition of value.
- **Largest value of one card** is the ceiling for a single card's value.
- **Largest balance after reloads** is the most the card may hold once value has been added. Only the Marlowe & Finch Gift Card is reloadable, and only for it does this ceiling ($2000.00) differ from the largest value of one card ($500.00).
- **Purchase fee** is $0.00 on every kind.
- **Monthly inactivity fee** is $0.00 on every kind: no Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards balance is reduced by a fee for being left unused.

## Points of judgement

- *Can a Merchandise Credit Card or a Registry Reward Card carry a few cents?* Yes. Their smallest issue value is $0.01, so a store-issued card can hold an amount to the cent from one cent upward, within its ceiling of $5000.00 or $1500.00 respectively.
- *What is the smallest Corporate Gift Card?* $25.00, up to $500.00 per card.

### Hypothetical headroom example

A hypothetical Marlowe & Finch Gift Card holds $1850.00. Its balance ceiling after reloads is $2000.00, so the room left is $2000.00 less $1850.00, which is $150.00. A $150.00 addition reaches the ceiling exactly; a $150.01 addition would take the balance above it. A hypothetical $8.00 addition is below the smallest load of $10.00.
